name: Bradley Wagoner

name: Cayden Bailey

name: Caroline Yates
note: WEAKER EVIDENCE, flagged for the verification pass. Confirmed by unanimous voice vote to the Graduate Advisory Council, 17 September 2024 (a university-committee appointment, not on its own proof of a Senate seat). But the same surname is then addressed directly as "Senator Yates" asking questions in floor debate on 1 October and 15 October 2024, and "Senator Yates" appears in the Senate's own roll-call absence list on 19 November 2024 - and roll call is definitionally of senators. No other Yates appears anywhere in the corpus, and no bill-authorship credit was found naming her seat. By 19 November 2024 the Graduate Advisory Council report reads "No Graduate Senator," suggesting she may have left the seat by then. Thanked by first name only ("Caroline") in the Campus Improvements and Sustainability Committee's farewell remarks, 15 April 2025.

name: Malick Ibrahim
note: WEAKEST EVIDENCE, flagged for the verification pass rather than confirmed. Listed by full name only as "Malick Ibrahim, Member" of the Organizational Aid Board from 15 October 2024 onward, alongside several confirmed senators - a board-membership credit, not a bill authorship or a direct Senate-seat statement. The bare surname "Senator Ibrahim" appears in nearly every absence list from 24 September 2024 through 4 March 2025, and "Senator Ibrahim made a motion to adjourn" on 10 September 2024. No bill authorship crediting a full name and seat, and no direct "Senator Malick Ibrahim" statement, was found anywhere in the 17 files.
